blocks.explanation:
Yeh rational equation (fraction wali equation) hai, kyunke \(x\) denominator (neeche wale hissay) mein aa raha hai.
Diya kya hai? Do fractions ka jama 1 ke barabar hai, aur \(x \neq 0\) bataya gaya hai.
Find kya karna hai? \(x\) ki woh tamam values jo equation ko sach bana dein.
Plan: sab se pehle fractions khatam karenge (LCD \(6x\) se multiply), phir quadratic ban jayegi jise factorize kar lenge, aur aakhir mein check karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{1}{3x} + \frac{4x}{6} = 1\), \(x \neq 0\).
Humein find karna hai: solution set.
Tareeqa: Fractions ke saath kaam mushkil hota hai, is liye har term ko LCD (lowest common denominator, yani sab se chhota common denominator) se multiply karenge. \(3x\) aur \(6\) dono \(6x\) mein poore taqseem ho jate hain, is liye LCD \(6x\) hai. Is ke baad seedhi quadratic equation reh jayegi.

Har term ko \(6x\) se multiply karein
\[6x \cdot \dfrac{1}{3x} + 6x \cdot \dfrac{4x}{6} = 6x\]
\[2 + 4x^2 = 6x\]
Kyun: \(6x \div 3x = 2\), to pehli fraction sirf 2 reh gayi; \(6x \div 6 = x\), to doosri \(x \cdot 4x = 4x^2\) ban gayi. Right side ka 1 bhi \(6x\) se multiply hua. Yeh multiply karna is liye jaiz hai ke \(x \neq 0\) diya hua hai, warna zero se multiply karke ghalat jawab aa sakta tha.
Dhyan dein: har term ko multiply karna hai, right side ko bhi; aksar bachay right side bhool jate hain.

Standard form mein likhein
\[4x^2 - 6x + 2 = 0\]
\[2x^2 - 3x + 1 = 0\]
Kyun: Quadratic equation hamesha \(ax^2 + bx + c = 0\) ki shakal mein solve hoti hai, yani ek taraf sab kuch aur doosri taraf zero. Phir har term 2 se divide kar di taake numbers chhote ho jayen aur factorize karna aasaan ho.

Factorize karein
\[2x^2 - 2x - x + 1 = 0\]
\[2x(x - 1) - 1(x - 1) = 0\]
\[(2x - 1)(x - 1) = 0\]
Kyun: Middle term break karne ka tareeqa: \(a \times c = 2 \times 1 = 2\). Aise do numbers chahiye jin ka product 2 aur sum \(-3\) ho; woh \(-2\) aur \(-1\) hain. Is liye \(-3x\) ko \(-2x - x\) likha, phir do do terms ka common nikala to \((x - 1)\) dono mein common aa gaya.

Har factor ko zero rakhein
\[2x - 1 = 0 \Rightarrow x = \dfrac{1}{2}\]
\[x - 1 = 0 \Rightarrow x = 1\]
Kyun: Agar do cheezon ka product zero ho to un mein se koi ek zaroor zero hogi. Dono values mein se koi bhi excluded value (0) nahi hai, is liye dono qabool hain.

Tasdeeq
\[x = 1:\ \dfrac{1}{3} + \dfrac{4}{6} = \dfrac{1}{3} + \dfrac{2}{3} = 1 \;\checkmark\]
\[x = \tfrac{1}{2}:\ \dfrac{2}{3} + \dfrac{1}{3} = 1 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(x = \frac{1}{2}\) par \(3x = \frac{3}{2}\), to \(\frac{1}{3/2} = \frac{2}{3}\); aur \(\frac{4(1/2)}{6} = \frac{2}{6} = \frac{1}{3}\). Dono values asal equation ko sach banati hain, is liye jawab pakka hai.

blocks.explanation:
Yeh bhi rational equation hai, lekin is mein ek khaas baat hai: \(\frac{x}{x+1}\) aur \(\frac{x+1}{x}\) ek doosre ka ulta (reciprocal) hain.
Diya kya hai? In dono ka jama \(\frac{5}{2}\) hai, aur \(x \neq -1, 0\).
Find kya karna hai? \(x\) ki values.
Plan: ek fraction ko naya naam \(y\) dein (substitution), \(y\) wali aasaan quadratic solve karein, phir wapas \(x\) par aayen.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{x}{x+1} + \frac{x+1}{x} = \frac{5}{2}\), \(x \neq -1, 0\).
Humein find karna hai: solution set.
Tareeqa: Jab ek hi cheez aur us ka ulta dono equation mein hon, to us cheez ko ek letter de dena kaam bahut chhota kar deta hai. Isay substitution method kehte hain. Seedha LCD se bhi ho sakta hai, magar algebra lambi ho jati hai.

Substitution karein
\[\text{Let } y = \dfrac{x}{x+1}\]
\[\text{then } \dfrac{x+1}{x} = \dfrac{1}{y}\]
\[y + \dfrac{1}{y} = \dfrac{5}{2}\]
Kyun: Kisi fraction ko ulta kar dein to woh us ka reciprocal ban jata hai. \(y\) ko ulta karein to \(\frac{1}{y}\). Ab equation mein sirf ek variable \(y\) hai.

Fractions khatam kar ke \(y\) nikalein
\[2y^2 + 2 = 5y\]
\[2y^2 - 5y + 2 = 0\]
\[(2y - 1)(y - 2) = 0\]
\[y = \dfrac{1}{2} \text{ or } y = 2\]
Kyun: LCD \(2y\) se multiply kiya: \(2y \cdot y = 2y^2\), \(2y \cdot \frac{1}{y} = 2\), \(2y \cdot \frac{5}{2} = 5y\). Factorize ke liye \(ac = 4\), aur \(-4\), \(-1\) ka product 4 aur sum \(-5\) hai: \(2y^2 - 4y - y + 2\).

\(y = 2\) se wapas \(x\) par
\[\dfrac{x}{x+1} = 2\]
\[x = 2x + 2\]
\[x = -2\]
Kyun: Cross multiply kiya, phir \(x\) wali terms ek taraf: \(x - 2x = 2\), yani \(-x = 2\).
Dhyan dein: \(y\) nikal kar ruk na jayen; sawal \(x\) ka hai, \(y\) sirf madadgaar tha.

\(y = \frac{1}{2}\) se wapas \(x\) par
\[\dfrac{x}{x+1} = \dfrac{1}{2}\]
\[2x = x + 1\]
\[x = 1\]
Kyun: Wohi cross multiplication. \(-2\) aur \(1\) mein se koi bhi excluded value (\(-1\) ya \(0\)) nahi, is liye dono qabool.

Tasdeeq
\[x = -2:\ \dfrac{-2}{-1} + \dfrac{-1}{-2} = 2 + \dfrac{1}{2} = \dfrac{5}{2} \;\checkmark\]
\[x = 1:\ \dfrac{1}{2} + \dfrac{2}{1} = \dfrac{5}{2} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Dono values se left side \(\frac{5}{2}\) banti hai. Negative ko negative se divide karne par positive aata hai, yeh yaad rakhein.

blocks.explanation:
Yeh rational equation hai jis mein teen alag denominators hain.
Diya kya hai? Left par do fractions ka jama, right par ek fraction; \(x \neq -1, -2, -5\).
Find kya karna hai? \(x\) ki values.
Plan: left wali do fractions ko ek fraction banayenge, phir cross multiply, phir quadratic solve aur check.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{1}{x+1} + \frac{2}{x+2} = \frac{7}{x+5}\), \(x \neq -1, -2, -5\).
Humein find karna hai: solution set.
Tareeqa: Left side ko ek fraction bana kar "ek fraction = ek fraction" ki shakal bana lete hain. Phir cross multiplication (upar wala neeche wale se tirchha multiply) se fractions khatam ho jati hain aur quadratic reh jati hai.

Left side ki fractions jama karein
\[\dfrac{(x+2) + 2(x+1)}{(x+1)(x+2)}\]
\[= \dfrac{3x + 4}{x^2 + 3x + 2}\]
Kyun: Common denominator \((x+1)(x+2)\) hai. Pehli fraction ke numerator ko \((x+2)\) se aur doosri ke numerator ko \((x+1)\) se multiply kiya. Upar: \(x + 2 + 2x + 2 = 3x + 4\). Neeche: \((x+1)(x+2) = x^2 + 2x + x + 2 = x^2 + 3x + 2\).

Cross multiply karein
\[(3x + 4)(x + 5) = 7(x^2 + 3x + 2)\]
\[3x^2 + 19x + 20 = 7x^2 + 21x + 14\]
Kyun: Agar \(\frac{p}{q} = \frac{r}{s}\) ho to \(ps = qr\). Left par \(3x^2 + 15x + 4x + 20\), aur right par 7 har term mein ghusa diya.
Dhyan dein: bracket ka multiplication har term ke saath karna hai; \(4 \times 5 = 20\) aksar chhoot jata hai.

Standard form
\[0 = 4x^2 + 2x - 6\]
\[2x^2 + x - 3 = 0\]
Kyun: Sab terms right side par le gaye kyunke wahan \(x^2\) ka coefficient bara hai, is se \(x^2\) positive rehta hai. Phir 2 se divide kiya.

Factorize kar ke solve karein
\[2x^2 + 3x - 2x - 3 = 0\]
\[x(2x + 3) - 1(2x + 3) = 0\]
\[(2x + 3)(x - 1) = 0\]
\[x = -\dfrac{3}{2} \text{ or } x = 1\]
Kyun: \(ac = -6\); \(3\) aur \(-2\) ka product \(-6\) aur sum \(1\) hai. Dono roots excluded values mein nahi, to dono qabool.

Tasdeeq
\[x = 1:\ \dfrac{1}{2} + \dfrac{2}{3} = \dfrac{7}{6},\ \dfrac{7}{6} \;\checkmark\]
\[x = -\tfrac{3}{2}:\ -2 + 4 = 2,\ \dfrac{7}{7/2} = 2 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(x = -\frac{3}{2}\) par \(x + 1 = -\frac{1}{2}\), \(x + 2 = \frac{1}{2}\), \(x + 5 = \frac{7}{2}\). To \(\frac{1}{-1/2} = -2\), \(\frac{2}{1/2} = 4\), aur right side \(2\). Dono taraf barabar.

blocks.prompt: 1 (iv) Solve the following equation: \(\frac{a}{ax-1} + \frac{b}{bx-1} = a + b;\ x \neq \frac{1}{a}, \frac{1}{b}\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh literal (letters wali) rational equation hai: \(a\) aur \(b\) constants hain, unknown sirf \(x\) hai.
Diya kya hai? Do fractions ka jama \(a + b\) ke barabar.
Find kya karna hai? \(x\), \(a\) aur \(b\) ki shakal mein.
Plan: \(a + b\) ko left le ja kar \(-b\) pehli fraction ke saath aur \(-a\) doosri ke saath jorenge; dono numerators ek jaise ban jayenge aur common factor nikal aayega.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \( rac{a}{ax-1} +  rac{b}{bx-1} = a + b\), \(x 
eq  rac{1}{a},  rac{1}{b}\) (aur \(a, b 
eq 0\), \(a + b 
eq 0\)).
Humein find karna hai: \(x\).
Tareeqa: Seedha LCD se multiply karein to lambi algebra banti hai. Smart tareeqa yeh hai ke \(a + b\) ko tor kar har fraction ke saath ek hissa rakhein. Tab dono numerators \(a + b - abx\) ban jate hain aur common factor bahar aa jata hai. Is sawal ko letters se ghabrana nahi; letters ko bhi numbers ki tarah treat karein.

Terms ko dobara tarteeb dein
\[\left(\dfrac{a}{ax-1} - b\right) + \left(\dfrac{b}{bx-1} - a\right) = 0\]
Kyun: Dono taraf se \(a + b\) minus kiya. Kaunsa letter kis fraction ke saath jaye, yeh hamari marzi hai; hum ne woh joda chuna jis se numerators barabar ban jayen.

Har bracket ko simplify karein
\[\dfrac{a}{ax-1} - b = \dfrac{a - abx + b}{ax - 1}\]
\[\dfrac{b}{bx-1} - a = \dfrac{b - abx + a}{bx - 1}\]
Kyun: \(b\) ko \(\frac{b(ax-1)}{ax-1}\) likha, to numerator \(a - b(ax - 1) = a - abx + b\). Isi tarah doosre mein \(b - a(bx - 1) = b - abx + a\). Dekhiye, dono numerators bilkul ek jaise hain.

Common factor bahar nikalein
\[(a + b - abx)\left[\dfrac{1}{ax-1} + \dfrac{1}{bx-1}\right] = 0\]
Kyun: Jab do terms mein ek hi cheez multiply ho rahi ho to use bahar nikal sakte hain, jaise \(kp + kq = k(p + q)\).

Pehla factor zero
\[a + b - abx = 0\]
\[x = \dfrac{a + b}{ab}\]
Kyun: Product zero hai to koi ek factor zero hoga. \(abx = a + b\), phir \(ab\) se divide kiya (jo zero nahi).

Doosra factor zero
\[\dfrac{1}{ax-1} + \dfrac{1}{bx-1} = 0\]
\[(bx - 1) + (ax - 1) = 0\]
\[(a + b)x = 2\]
\[x = \dfrac{2}{a + b}\]
Kyun: \((ax-1)(bx-1)\) se multiply kar ke fractions khatam kin, phir \(x\) wali terms jama kin: \(ax + bx = (a + b)x\).

\(x = \frac{a+b}{ab}\) ki tasdeeq
\[ax - 1 = \dfrac{a + b}{b} - 1 = \dfrac{a}{b}\]
\[bx - 1 = \dfrac{a + b}{a} - 1 = \dfrac{b}{a}\]
\[\dfrac{a}{a/b} + \dfrac{b}{b/a} = b + a \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\frac{a}{a/b} = a \times \frac{b}{a} = b\), aur isi tarah doosra \(a\). Left side \(a + b\) ban gayi, jo right side hai.

\(x = \frac{2}{a+b}\) ki tasdeeq
\[ax - 1 = \dfrac{a - b}{a + b}\]
\[bx - 1 = \dfrac{b - a}{a + b}\]
\[\dfrac{a(a+b)}{a-b} - \dfrac{b(a+b)}{a-b} = a + b \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(ax - 1 = \frac{2a - (a + b)}{a + b} = \frac{a - b}{a + b}\). Doosri fraction ka denominator \(b - a = -(a - b)\) hai, is liye minus aaya. Phir \(\frac{(a - b)(a + b)}{a - b} = a + b\).
Dhyan dein: yeh root tab hi chalta hai jab \(a \neq b\); agar \(a = b\) ho to yeh value denominator ko zero kar deti hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (v) Solve the following equation: \(\frac{x+1}{x-1} + \frac{x-1}{x+1} = 2,\ x \neq 1,\ x \neq -1\).
blocks.explanation:
Rational equation hai; dono denominators ka product \(x^2 - 1\) banta hai.
Diya kya hai? Do fractions ka jama 2, aur \(x \neq \pm 1\).
Find kya karna hai? \(x\) ki values, ya yeh dikhana ke koi value nahi.
Plan: fractions jama, denominator khatam, simplify, aur dekhna ke kya bachta hai. Is sawal mein ek surprise hai!
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{x+1}{x-1} + \frac{x-1}{x+1} = 2\), \(x \neq \pm 1\).
Humein find karna hai: solution set.
Tareeqa: Common denominator \((x - 1)(x + 1) = x^2 - 1\) (difference of squares) le kar fractions jama karenge, phir dono taraf us se multiply karenge.

Left side ko ek fraction banayen
\[\dfrac{(x+1)^2 + (x-1)^2}{x^2 - 1} = 2\]
Kyun: Pehli fraction ke upar neeche \((x + 1)\) se aur doosri ke upar neeche \((x - 1)\) se multiply kiya, is liye numerators squares ban gaye.

Numerator expand karein
\[(x^2 + 2x + 1) + (x^2 - 2x + 1)\]
\[= 2x^2 + 2\]
Kyun: \((p + q)^2 = p^2 + 2pq + q^2\) aur \((p - q)^2 = p^2 - 2pq + q^2\). \(+2x\) aur \(-2x\) cancel ho gaye.

Denominator khatam karein
\[2x^2 + 2 = 2(x^2 - 1)\]
\[2x^2 + 2 = 2x^2 - 2\]
\[2 = -2\]
Kyun: \(x^2 - 1\) se multiply kiya (jaiz hai kyunke \(x \neq \pm 1\)). Dono taraf se \(2x^2\) minus kiya to \(x\) bilkul ghayab ho gaya aur \(2 = -2\) bacha.

Natija
Kyun: \(2 = -2\) kisi bhi \(x\) ke liye sach nahi ho sakta. Is ka matlab hai ke koi bhi number is equation ko sach nahi banata, yani solution set khaali (empty set) hai. Misaal ke taur par \(x = 0\) rakhein: \(\frac{1}{-1} + \frac{-1}{1} = -2\), jo 2 nahi. Ghabrayen nahi: har equation ka hal hona zaroori nahi; "no solution" bhi ek sahi jawab hai.
Dhyan dein: \(2 = -2\) dekh kar yeh na samjhein ke aap ne ghalti ki hai; pehle apna kaam check karein, aur agar sahi ho to empty set likhein.
blocks.final_answer: Solution set \(= \{\ \}\) (empty set): koi hal nahi

blocks.explanation:
Yeh radical equation hai, yani \(x\) square root ke andar hai. Khaas baat: \(x^2 + 5x\) root ke andar bhi hai aur bahar bhi (\(3x^2 + 15x = 3(x^2 + 5x)\)).
Diya kya hai? Ek equation jis mein root aur quadratic dono hain.
Find kya karna hai? \(x\) ki real values.
Plan: poore root ko \(y\) naam dein, \(y\) ki quadratic solve karein, sirf \(y \geq 0\) rakhein, phir \(x\) nikal kar check karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(3x^2 + 15x - 2\sqrt{x^2 + 5x + 1} = 2\).
Humein find karna hai: solution set.
Tareeqa: Agar seedha root ko akela kar ke square karein to degree 4 ki equation ban jayegi, jo bahut mushkil hai. Is liye dekhte hain ke \(3x^2 + 15x = 3(x^2 + 5x)\), aur \(x^2 + 5x\) root ke andar bhi hai. Root ko ek letter de dein to aasaan quadratic ban jati hai.

Substitution karein
\[\text{Let } y = \sqrt{x^2 + 5x + 1},\ y \geq 0\]
\[x^2 + 5x = y^2 - 1\]
\[3x^2 + 15x = 3y^2 - 3\]
Kyun: \(y\) ko square karein to \(y^2 = x^2 + 5x + 1\), is liye \(x^2 + 5x = y^2 - 1\). Phir 3 se multiply kiya. Square root kabhi negative nahi hota, is liye \(y \geq 0\) ki shart yaad rakhni hai.

Sahi \(y\) chunein
\[y = \dfrac{5}{3} \quad (y = -1 \text{ rejected})\]
Kyun: \(y\) ek square root hai, aur square root \(-1\) ke barabar ho hi nahi sakta. Is liye \(y = -1\) chhor diya.
Dhyan dein: yeh qadam bhool jayen to ghalat (extra) jawab aa jate hain.

Wapas \(x\) par
\[x^2 + 5x + 1 = \dfrac{25}{9}\]
\[9x^2 + 45x + 9 = 25\]
\[9x^2 + 45x - 16 = 0\]
Kyun: \(\sqrt{x^2 + 5x + 1} = \frac{5}{3}\) ke dono taraf square kiye, phir fraction hatane ke liye 9 se multiply kiya.

Tasdeeq
\[x^2 + 5x = \dfrac{16}{9} \text{ for both values}\]
\[3 \cdot \dfrac{16}{9} - 2\sqrt{\dfrac{25}{9}} = \dfrac{16}{3} - \dfrac{10}{3} = 2 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(x = \frac{1}{3}\) par \(x^2 + 5x = \frac{1}{9} + \frac{15}{9} = \frac{16}{9}\); \(x = -\frac{16}{3}\) par \(\frac{256}{9} - \frac{240}{9} = \frac{16}{9}\). Dono ke liye left side 2 aati hai, to dono jawab sahi hain.

blocks.explanation:
Radical equation hai jis mein do square roots hain.
Diya kya hai? Do roots ka jama 7.
Find kya karna hai? \(x\) ki real value.
Plan: ek root ko akela karein, square karein, doosre root ko akela karein, phir square karein. Square karne se kabhi kabhi jhoote (extraneous) roots aa jate hain, is liye har jawab ko asal equation mein check karna lazmi hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\sqrt{2x+8} + \sqrt{x+5} = 7\).
Humein find karna hai: solution set.
Tareeqa: Square root hatane ka tareeqa square karna hai. Lekin do roots ek saath hon to pehle ek ko akela karte hain, warna square karne par bhi root bacha rehta hai. Extraneous root woh jhoota jawab hai jo square karne ki wajah se aa jata hai, lekin asal equation ko poora nahi karta.

Ek root akela kar ke square karein
\[\sqrt{2x+8} = 7 - \sqrt{x+5}\]
\[2x + 8 = 49 - 14\sqrt{x+5} + x + 5\]
Kyun: \((7 - q)^2 = 49 - 14q + q^2\), jahan \(q = \sqrt{x+5}\), aur \(q^2 = x + 5\).
Dhyan dein: \((7 - q)^2\) ko \(49 + q^2\) likhna bahut aam ghalti hai; beech wala \(-14q\) zaroor likhein.

Bachay hue root ko akela karein
\[x - 46 = -14\sqrt{x+5}\]
\[14\sqrt{x+5} = 46 - x\]
Kyun: Left se \(x + 54\) minus kiya: \(2x + 8 - x - 54 = x - 46\). Phir dono taraf \(-1\) se multiply kiya taake root wali term positive ho.

Factorize karein
\[(x - 4)(x - 284) = 0\]
\[x = 4 \text{ or } x = 284\]
Kyun: Aise do numbers chahiye jin ka product 1136 aur sum 288 ho: \(4 \times 284 = 1136\), \(4 + 284 = 288\).

Dono ki tasdeeq
\[x = 4:\ \sqrt{16} + \sqrt{9} = 4 + 3 = 7 \;\checkmark\]
\[x = 284:\ \sqrt{576} + \sqrt{289} = 41 \neq 7\]
Kyun: \(x = 284\) extraneous hai. Wajah: is par \(46 - x\) negative ban jata hai, jabke \(14\sqrt{x+5}\) kabhi negative nahi ho sakta. Square karne ne yeh fark chhupa diya tha. Is liye sirf \(x = 4\) sahi hai.

blocks.explanation:
Radical equation hai; ek root pehle se left par akela hai.
Diya kya hai? \(\sqrt{3x+4}\) barabar hai \(2 + \sqrt{2x-4}\) ke. Root ke andar negative nahi ho sakta, is liye \(x \geq 2\) chahiye.
Find kya karna hai? \(x\) ki real values.
Plan: square, bachay root ko akela, phir square, quadratic solve, aur dono jawab check.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\sqrt{3x+4} = 2 + \sqrt{2x-4}\).
Humein find karna hai: solution set.
Tareeqa: Do dafa square kar ke dono roots hatayenge, phir har jawab ko asal equation mein check karenge, kyunke squaring jhoote jawab de sakti hai.

Dono taraf square karein
\[3x + 4 = 4 + 4\sqrt{2x-4} + 2x - 4\]
\[3x + 4 = 2x + 4\sqrt{2x-4}\]
Kyun: \((2 + q)^2 = 4 + 4q + q^2\), jahan \(q = \sqrt{2x-4}\). Right side par \(4 - 4\) cancel ho gaya.

Root akela kar ke dobara square
\[x + 4 = 4\sqrt{2x-4}\]
\[x^2 + 8x + 16 = 16(2x - 4)\]
Kyun: Dono taraf se \(2x\) minus kiya. Phir square: \((x + 4)^2 = x^2 + 8x + 16\) aur \((4\sqrt{2x-4})^2 = 16(2x - 4)\).
Dhyan dein: \(4\sqrt{\ }\) ko square karte waqt 4 ka bhi square (16) hota hai.

Quadratic solve karein
\[x^2 + 8x + 16 = 32x - 64\]
\[x^2 - 24x + 80 = 0\]
\[(x - 4)(x - 20) = 0\]
\[x = 4 \text{ or } x = 20\]
Kyun: Product 80 aur sum 24 wale numbers 4 aur 20 hain.

Dono ki tasdeeq
\[x = 4:\ \sqrt{16} = 4,\ 2 + \sqrt{4} = 4 \;\checkmark\]
\[x = 20:\ \sqrt{64} = 8,\ 2 + \sqrt{36} = 8 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Is dafa dono values asal equation ko poora karti hain, koi extraneous root nahi. Lekin yeh check ke baghair pata nahi chal sakta tha.

blocks.explanation:
Radical equation hai jis mein teen roots hain.
Diya kya hai? Do roots ka jama teesre root ke barabar.
Find kya karna hai? \(x\) ki real value.
Plan: dono taraf square (left par do roots ka jama hai), bacha hua product wala root akela, dobara square, solve aur check.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\sqrt{x+7} + \sqrt{x+2} = \sqrt{6x+13}\).
Humein find karna hai: solution set.
Tareeqa: Pehli squaring se right ka root khatam aur left par sirf ek root (product wala) bachta hai. Use akela kar ke dobara square karte hain. Aakhir mein check, kyunke squaring extraneous roots de sakti hai.

Dono taraf square karein
\[(x + 7) + (x + 2) + 2\sqrt{(x+7)(x+2)} = 6x + 13\]
Kyun: \((p + q)^2 = p^2 + 2pq + q^2\). Yahan \(p^2 = x + 7\), \(q^2 = x + 2\), aur \(2pq = 2\sqrt{x+7}\sqrt{x+2} = 2\sqrt{(x+7)(x+2)}\).
Dhyan dein: \(\sqrt{p} + \sqrt{q}\) ka square \(p + q\) nahi hota; beech wali \(2\sqrt{pq}\) term zaroor aati hai.

Root ko akela karein
\[2\sqrt{x^2 + 9x + 14} = 4x + 4\]
\[\sqrt{x^2 + 9x + 14} = 2x + 2\]
Kyun: Left se \(2x + 9\) right le gaye: \(6x + 13 - 2x - 9 = 4x + 4\). Phir 2 se divide. Andar \((x+7)(x+2) = x^2 + 9x + 14\).

Dobara square kar ke solve karein
\[x^2 + 9x + 14 = 4x^2 + 8x + 4\]
\[3x^2 - x - 10 = 0\]
\[(3x + 5)(x - 2) = 0\]
\[x = 2 \text{ or } x = -\dfrac{5}{3}\]
Kyun: \((2x + 2)^2 = 4x^2 + 8x + 4\). Sab right par le gaye. Factorize: \(ac = -30\), \(-6\) aur \(5\) ka product \(-30\) aur sum \(-1\).

Dono ki tasdeeq
\[x = 2:\ \sqrt{9} + \sqrt{4} = 5,\ \sqrt{25} = 5 \;\checkmark\]
\[x = -\tfrac{5}{3}:\ 2x + 2 = -\tfrac{4}{3} < 0\]
Kyun: \(x = -\frac{5}{3}\) par \(\sqrt{x^2 + 9x + 14}\) ko \(-\frac{4}{3}\) ke barabar hona padta, jo na-mumkin hai kyunke root kabhi negative nahi. Seedha check bhi: left \(\sqrt{16/3} + \sqrt{1/3} \approx 2.89\), right \(\sqrt{3} \approx 1.73\). Is liye yeh extraneous hai; sirf \(x = 2\) sahi.

blocks.explanation:
Radical equation hai jis mein do roots ka farq (difference) diya hai.
Diya kya hai? \(\sqrt{x+5} - \sqrt{x-3} = 2\); root ke andar negative na ho, is liye \(x \geq 3\).
Find kya karna hai? \(x\) ki real value.
Plan: ek root ko right le jayen, square, doosra root akela, phir square aur check.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\sqrt{x+5} - \sqrt{x-3} = 2\).
Humein find karna hai: solution set.
Tareeqa: Seedha square karne ki bajaye pehle \(\sqrt{x+5} = 2 + \sqrt{x-3}\) likhte hain, taake dono taraf positive ho. Is se squaring aasaan aur saaf rehti hai.

Akela kar ke square karein
\[\sqrt{x+5} = 2 + \sqrt{x-3}\]
\[x + 5 = 4 + 4\sqrt{x-3} + x - 3\]
Kyun: \((2 + q)^2 = 4 + 4q + q^2\), jahan \(q = \sqrt{x-3}\).

Bacha hua root akela karein
\[4 = 4\sqrt{x-3}\]
\[\sqrt{x-3} = 1\]
Kyun: Right par \(4 - 3 + x = x + 1\) hai. Dono taraf se \(x + 1\) minus kiya to \(x\) cancel ho gaya aur \(4 = 4\sqrt{x-3}\) bacha. Phir 4 se divide kiya.

Square kar ke solve karein
\[x - 3 = 1\]
\[x = 4\]
Kyun: Square karne se aakhri root bhi khatam ho gaya. Is sawal mein quadratic banti hi nahi, seedha linear equation reh gayi.

Tasdeeq
\[\sqrt{9} - \sqrt{1} = 3 - 1 = 2 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(x = 4\) asal equation ko poora karta hai, is liye jawab pakka hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki answer key mein Sawal 1 ke pandrah (15) parts, (i) se (xv) tak, ke jawab diye gaye hain, jabke exercise mein sirf das parts, (i) se (x) tak, chhape hue hain. Faltu jawab (xi) \(\{0, 2\}\), (xii) \(\{0, -3\}\), (xiii) \(\{2, 4\}\), (xiv) \(\{2, 3\}\) aur (xv) \(\left\{-\frac{1}{2}, \frac{1}{2}\right\}\) kisi chhape hue sawal ke nahi hain, is liye un ko solve karne ki zaroorat nahi; un ko nazar-andaaz karein. (i) se (x) tak key ke jawab upar wale hal se milte hain.
